rv.q: I'll admit that Waitress is in my top ten shows of all time so I may be biased, but this is a flawless production.
Everything about this Tony-nominated musical brought so much joy and happiness into my life.
A slice of pure musical heaven has landed in the Live Music Capital of the World.
Waitress is a perfect slice of musical theatre, and what makes it shine is how confidently it knows itself.

cn.t: The 10th Anniversary Tour of Waitress earns rave reviews, with critics praising Sara Bareilles' pop-rock score and the production's masterful blend of soaring vocals and heartfelt storytelling.
